meta.title: Tudert n wass ɣer wass di Qarṭaǧ — axxam, ṭṭabla, llebsa, ismawen, tisuɣyin
meta.desc: Tudert di Qarṭaǧ : axxam n Kerkouane, puls punica n Caton, ccṛab passum, llebsa d lǥawahar, ismawen ipuniyen d lmeɛna-nsen (Hanibal, Hasdrubal, Hamilkar…), awitay, tisuɣyin, aẓawan akked tememmit.
hero.chip: Qarṭaǧ · Tudert n wass ɣer wass
hero.title: Tudert n wass ɣer wass di Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: D acu ččan, amek țelsan, amek i semman i warraw-nsen ? Tiririt teqqim deg ucerreg : ixxamen yettwasellen, ifecka n yimḍalen, agar n tira tiwezlanin, akked tamuɣli, aṭas n tikwal yesḥeqqṛen, n Yigrikiyen d Iṛumaniyen.
hero.alt: Iberdan d ixxamen ipuniyen ittwasellen n Kerkouane, ɣer rrif n lebḥer
hero.caption: Kerkouane, Ras Addar : tamdint tapunit yeqqimen akken i telli deg lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa

how.title: Amek i t-nessen ?
how.items.0.v: Kerkouane, i yeǧǧan deg ammas n lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa war ma tettwabna daɣen, akked yigrawen ipuniyen n Byrsa, sbeggnen-d ixxamen ; imḍalen fkan-d lǥab, lǥawahar, iwuraren.
how.items.1.v: Agar n izran n usfel, s telqey n tofet, fkan-d ismawen, lxedmat, taseddast n twaculin, kra n tikwal azemz. Wezlanin, qrib akk d ayen n ddin.
how.items.2.v: Caton, Plaute, Platon, Tite-Live neɣ Justin meslayen ɣef Qarṭaǧ seg berra, aṭas n tikwal d iɛdawen. Nbeddeṛ-iten, nḥerz tamuɣli tasmeyyit.
house.title: Ɣer tama n ammas
house.intro: Ixxamen ipuniyen ur qqimen ara ala deg lqaɛa, maca ḥekkun-d tudert n twacult : aman, ẓẓiwan, lxusuyya.
house.alt: Tɣawsa n uɣessel tapunit s lmertel azegzaw, s ukersi, di Kerkouane
house.caption: Tɣawsa n uɣessel s ukersi, Kerkouane
house.rows.0.v: Iberdan iwεren, tigejda yemsaɛdalen : di Kerkouane am deg igrawen i gettwassemman Magun d Hanibal di Qarṭaǧ, yal axxam yesεa ammas yeldin ɣer igenni.
house.rows.1.v: Abrid aqcic yeqqen abrid ɣer ammas : seg berra, ur ttwalin ara tudert n wexxam. Taxxamt ɣef webrid tezmer ad tili d lmaɣaza.
house.rows.2.v: Yal axxam yesεa lǥab-is, yettčaṭ s waman n ugeffur ; laberat yețjemmaɛ aman iqebḥen. Aman d lxedma tudmawant.
house.rows.3.v: Di Kerkouane, aṭas n ixxamen sεan taxxamt tamecṭuḥt n waman s tɣawsa n uɣessel, s ukersi : lɛawan idris deg ddunit taqdimt n zzman-nni.
house.rows.4.v: Pavimentum punicum, lmertel azeggaɣ ɛemmṛen s iqeṭṭuɛen n yizran, yesεa kra n tikwal acaraf n Tanit qrib tewwurt.
house.rows.5.v: Di Qarṭaǧ, tsidasin sbeggnent-d yiwen neɣ aṭas n yiḥedrayen ; Appien yemmeslay ɣef ixxamen n sețța iḥedrayen, war asteqqen asenfarrutan.
table.title: Irden, lǥebna, tamment akked uslem
table.intro: Ulac adlis n lmakla apunik i d-wwḍen ɣur-neɣ. Nesnulfa lmakla s wayen i d-yeqqimen deg ikecfan, ifecka akked kra n yiḏrisen ilatiniyen.
recipe.title: Puls punica
recipe.ing.modern.0.n: n ikkil n épeautre neɣ amidonnier
recipe.steps.cato.0: Sers alica deg waman, ǧǧ-it ad yesseww s telqey.
recipe.steps.cato.2: Rnu lǥebna tamaynut, tamment akked tmellalt ; semsel akk.
recipe.steps.modern.0: Sers ikkil deg waman isemmaḏen azal n 1 ɣer 2 n yisragen, syen smir aman.
recipe.steps.modern.2: Rnu lǥebna, tamment akked tmellalt ; semsel armi d talɣa yemsedway.
recipe.steps.modern.3: Seww-it s times fessusen deg tqedrurt tḥerrek, 15 ɣer 20 n tesdatin, armi d talɣa n tεesimt yezzayen. Fk-it ad yečč d azayez.
recipe.notes.cato: Caton ur d-yefka ara lweqt ne sshana : lṭar aṛumani yeẕẕal azal n 327 g.
recipe.notes.modern: Lmeqyasat n Caton ttwasnulfan ɣer igram. Lweqt n uɣessel, aseww d yibdilen d imsumar imaynuten, mačči d isɣulal iqdimen.
cato.latin: « Pultem punicam sic coquito. Libram alicae in aquam indito, facito uti bene madeat… »
cato.tr: « Seww tεesimt tapunit akka. Sers lṭar n alica deg waman, ǧǧ-it ad yesseww s telqey… »
cato.src: Caton Amɣar, De agricultura, 85 (ammas n lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa)
cato.warn: Laḥḏer : d talɣa taṛumanit « s wudem apunik ». Teqqar-d ayen i d-ssawalen Iṛumaniyen ɣer Qarṭaǧ, mačči s laṣel ayen i ččan Iqarṭaǧiyen yal ass. Tεesimt n yirden tella daɣen d lmakla tagejdant n Iṛumaniyen.
food.0.d: Irden d ciεir gant laṣel n lmakla, deg tfarfarin, aɣrum d tεesimin. Tugna n ukufi n talaḥt, seg wudem n tabuna i yettwaseqdacen mazal ass-a di Tunisia, yettwafen deg weẓekka n Qarṭaǧ.
food.1.d: Aṣaweḏ, islman iqquren neɣ iqqesen, ṣṣedfa ; akked garum, lqut n uslem yettwasbibicen i d-yesfeṛqen umaḏal apunik aseqdec-ines ɣef Lebḥer Ageraɣlan.
food.2.d: Tiini, aẓalim, uzemmur, uluz ; ṛṛumman, i gessawalen Iṛumaniyen « tazart tapunit » (malum punicum, Pline Amɣar, adlis XIII) ; tiẓuṛin n tazdayt, acaraf i yeɣfen idrimen n Qarṭaǧ.
food.3.d: Magun yefka talɣa n ccṛab-agi n uẓalim yeqqur ɣef yiṭij imbeɛd yettwaɛemmren deg wučči n uẓalim ; ameǥeri aṛumani Columelle yeɣra-t (De re rustica, XII, 39).
sober.0.d: Akken i d-yeqqar Platon, taɣardast taqarṭaǧit tegdel ccṛab i yiɛeskriyen deg teklal, i yimḥekmen deg useggas-nsen n tiẓyawt, i yimsegmaḏ n lbabur akked yimḥekmen deg lxedma.
sober.1.d: Iwakken ad yesken aɛdaw ur yelli ara ala krad wussan n lebḥer, Caton yesken-d, akken qqaren, deg Ssenaṭ tazart tafrint yettwagezmen di Qarṭaǧ (Pline Amɣar, XV, 74-76).
sober.2.d: Justin (XIX, 1) yefka i ugellid n Pers Darius lameṛ yegdel i Yiqarṭaǧiyen ad ččen aqjun. Tadyant-agi, tweḥḥed teḍheṛ-d lweqt aṭṭas, teqqim ur tettwasenqes ara.
dress.title: Aglim, aẓeɛfran akked lǥawahar
dress.intro: Ula d yiwet llebsa tapunit ur teqqim ara. Nessen-tent s izran, talaḥt, lkafen — akked ucenfiṛ n ibeṛṛaniyen.
dress.steleAlt: Azru yettwagezmen s ukahin s tqendurt tazegzagt d uɣummu aεlayen, yeṭṭef aqcic
dress.steleCap: Azru yettwassemman « n lkahen d uqcic », tofet n Qarṭaǧ, lqern wis 4 send Ɛisa (asinag n Bardo)
dress.pendAlt: Kuẓ n ucenfiṛen n djaǧ yeẕẕuɣuṛen, iqerra s ttawt, allen tiwessaren
dress.pendCap: Ucenfiṛen n djaǧ, Qarṭaǧ, lqern wis 4 – 3 send Ɛisa
dress.rows.0.v: Irgazen d tilawin ṭṭfen taqendurt tɣezfant, war tsiɣdin aṭas n tikwal : akka i d-yeg Plaute Aqarṭaǧi Hanun deg tectaḥit-ines Poenulus (tazwart n lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa).
dress.rows.1.v: Taqendurt n uɣes, aɣummu εlayen, aqerru yettwagerḏen : d tugna n uzru nnig-agi. Silius Italicus yeḥka-d am akken lemqedmin n Melqart di Gadès, drus iḍaṛṛen, εebban aɣes (Punica, III).
dress.rows.2.v: Abeṛnus yesmed llebsa. Aẓeɛfran, i d-yettwaksen seg murex, yettwaxdem deg wemkan-nni : Kerkouane tefka-d igar n ṣṣedfa yettwarẓen.
dress.rows.3.v: Ucenfiṛen akked talaḥt sbeggnen-d irgazen tecban, tilawin yeɣummen neɣ yesɛan acewwaf iɣezfen yeɣlin ɣef tgecrar.
dress.rows.4.v: Timeqyasin ɛemmṛen, tiqenniḍent, lxwatem n tnzert (nezem), tixxamin-ṭṭwabeɛ : ddheb d izran iqesḥen țțusentmen aṭas.
dress.rows.5.v: Iqbac n djaǧ yecṭaḥen, isɣuyan n lebxur, lemrayat n ṣṣfeṛ ddan akked yemmuten : laḥẕar n lǥetta yekcem armi d weẓekka.
dress.rows.6.v: Ucenfiṛen imeẓyanen n djaǧ, tugniwin n Bès neɣ til Oudjat, ikufan n ddheb neɣ n nnuqra εebban deg umgerḏ : țțusentmen seg tiṭ tucmit.
dress.soft.title: « Taẓẓuɣurt » tapunit ?
dress.soft.paras.0: I Yigrikiyen d Iṛumaniyen, Ifiniqiyen d imsezzenzen imcewwfen, ɛemmṛen s lɛeṭṭar d lǥawahar, mačči d irgazen. Plaute yekkes-d seg-s ccetla : taqendurt tɣezfant, war tsiɣdin, aqeddac s imeẓẓuɣen ițwaqecmen s lxwatem.
dress.soft.paras.1: Lɛalamat-agi llant d timasayin deg Ccerq Aqrib, ur d-qqaren wacemma ɣef lεib. Tite-Live s yiman-is yeḥka-d Hanibal yettuɛeqlen, yeṭṭes ɣef lqaɛa deg uberṭel n uɛeskri, yelsa am imdukkal-is.
dress.soft.src: Plaute, Poenulus, v. 975 d wayen i d-iḍfaren · Tite-Live, XXI, 4
names.title: Ismawen d tẓallit
names.intro: Tugget n yismawen iqarṭaǧiyen d tefyar tiwezlanin i d-yessawlen i yillu. Ttwarun war inzizen, seg uyeffus ɣer uzelmaḍ, aṭas n tikwal wwḍen-d ɣur-neɣ ttwabeddlen s tegrikit d telatinit.
names.items.hannibal.name: Hanibal
names.items.hannibal.m: « Lḥif n Baal », « Baal yefka lḥif »
names.items.hannibal.d: Isem iεeǧben aṭas deg tira, aṭas uqbel mmi-s n Hamilkar Barka.
names.items.hasdrubal.name: Hasdrubal
names.items.hasdrubal.d: Yeṭṭef-it argaz n yelli-s akked mmi-s n Hamilkar, akked anezwi aneggaru n Qarṭaǧ deg 146.
names.items.hamilcar.name: Hamilkar
names.items.hamilcar.d: Tɣuri yemεeǧben akteṛ (ʾḥ-mlqrt) : isem yesduklen bab-is akked yillu n Ṣur.
names.items.bomilcar.name: Bomilkar
names.items.bomilcar.d: Yebɣa ad yini ddaw n uḥraz-is. Yeṭṭef-it anezwi i yeεreḏen ad yeṭṭef lḥekma deg 308 send Ɛisa (Diodore, XX, 44).
names.items.himilcon.name: Himilcon
names.items.himilcon.d: Milkat, « Tagellidt », tezmer ad tili d alqab n tyillut ; tɣuri-agi mazal-itt tettwasmeyya. Isem n umsegmaḏ n Ugaraw n Turuft (Pline, II, 169).
names.items.magon.name: Magun
names.items.magon.d: Ahat seg uẓaṛ mgn, « ad yefk ». Isem n umeǥeri d gma-s ameẕyan n Hanibal.
names.items.hannon.name: Hanun
names.items.hannon.d: Talɣa tawezlant n yisem s ḥn-, yillu-ines yettwaεqel war ma yettwabder. Isem n umsegmaḏ n Tiklarit akked Hanun Ameqqran.
names.items.adherbal.name: Adherbal
names.items.adherbal.d: Yeṭṭef-it unemhal n lebḥer i yenɣelben lebḥer aṛumani di Drépane deg 249 send Ɛisa (Polybe, I, 49-51).
names.items.abdmelqart.name: Abdmelqart
names.items.abdmelqart.d: Ismawen s ʿbd-, « aqeddac n », ḍfeṛen-t s yisem n yillu, llan gar wid ițɛemmren akteṛ ɣef izran.
names.items.amotmelqart.name: Amotmelqart
names.items.amotmelqart.d: Talɣa tanṭawt, tettwaf ɣef izran n usfel n Qarṭaǧ, anida tilawin ggent-d asfel s yisem-nsent s yiman-nsent.
names.items.sophonisbe.name: Sofonisba
names.items.sophonisbe.d: Talɣa tagrikit d talatinit n yisem apunik i d-yettwasersen Ṣapanbaʿal : tɣuri i gezmer ad tili, mačči d tamagnut.
names.items.elissa.name: Elisa
names.items.elissa.d: Aktab agrikan n yisem afiniqi i d-yettwasersen ʾlšt ; lmeɛna-s, am win n Didun, mazal-it yettwasmeyya.
names.parts.title: Ifecka n yismawen
names.parts.p: Isem apunik yesdukkel isem n yillu akked wawal neɣ amyag. Deg tira, yal yiwen yeṭṭef lǥerima-ines, kra n tikwal deg aṭas n tsutawin (« X mmi-s n Y mmi-s n Z ») ; ismawen-nni s yiman-nsen ttɛawaden seg jeddi armi d arraw, syen i d-yekka waṭas n Hanibal d Hasdrubal.
time.title: Wagguren, tisuɣyin akked yilluten n wexxam
time.intro: Awitay apunik yettwassen kan s ucerreg : kra n yismawen n wagguren, kra n tisuɣyin, s telqey s tira akked yimeskaren igrikiyen.
time.months.title: Wagguren n waggur
time.months.p: Awal yrḥ yebɣa ad yini aggur akked waggur n wasegas. Di Qarṭaǧ, iseggasen ttwaseklan s yismawen n sin sufeṭ i yezgan. Atan wagguren yettwassnen deg tira tifiniqiyin akked tipuniyen ; aẓwel-nsen deg useggas mazal yettwasnulfa.
time.months.notes.0: « Asfel n yiṭij ». Yettwabder ɣef tḥuṛiyin n ddheb n Pyrgi (azal n 500 send Ɛisa).
time.months.notes.1: Lmeɛna yettwasmeyya, ahat yeqqen ɣer usijji (aẓaṛ rpʾ).
time.months.notes.7: Bul, yettwabder ɣef welɣem n Eshmunazar di Ṣaydun akked deg Linǥil (1 Rois 6, 38).
time.feast.title: Aḥuzi n Melqart
time.feast.paras.0: Di Ṣur, agellid Hiram yesres, akken qqaren, « aḥuzi » (s tegrikit égersis) n Héraclès-Melqart (Ménandre n Éphèse, yettwabder sɣur Flavius Josèphe, Tɣawsiwin Taɛebraniyin, VIII, 146). Tira tipuniyin bedrent alqab n lmeqdem, « win i d-isekkren illu » (mqm ʾlm), i gettwaqqnen ɣer lɛada-agi ; tikli-ines ur tettwassen ara.
time.feast.paras.1: Yal aseggas, Qarṭaǧ tettazen ɣer Ṣur tarbaɛt n iεeggalet s wasfel i Melqart : iεeggalet iqarṭaǧiyen llan dinna lawan n uḥeṛṣ n Alexandre, deg 332 (Arrien, Anabase, II, 24).
time.home.title: Iyilluten deg wexxam
time.home.rows.0.v: Di Kerkouane, kra n lǥab n tewwurt yesεa acaraf n Tanit : asentem yettwasersen anida yekcem umdan.
time.home.rows.1.v: Ucenfiṛen yettemcaben yettwaseklaqen, lxwatem n Bès neɣ Horus : sfeḍen leǥnun seg wexxam am seg lǥetta.
time.home.rows.2.v: Ikufan n zzit d isɣuyan n lebxur, kra n tikwal s telɣa n uqerru n yillu, xeddmen deg wass ɣer wass am deg udin.
time.home.rows.3.v: Deg 396 send Ɛisa, Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef udin agrikan n Déméter akked Korè (Diodore, XIV, 77) : lɛada tezger-itt daɣen.
kids.title: Tibendayer d ikufan n warraw
kids.intro: Imḍalen n warraw akked tugniwin n talaḥt fkan-d tamuɣli, mačči akmilen, ɣef wurar akked usegmi.
kids.alt: Takatut tapunit n talaḥt : tameṭṭut teɣummu teṭṭef tabendayer ɣef idmaren-is
kids.caption: Tameṭṭut s tbendayer, talaḥt, asinag agraɣlan n Bardo
kids.rows.0.v: Tugniwin sbeggnen-d tilawin ṭṭfent tabendayer ɣef idmaren-nsent ; amaḏal afiniqi yessen daɣen imeẕẕuɣen n ssnitra snat. Tugniwin-agi aṭas n tikwal qqnent ɣer udin.
kids.rows.1.v: Imḍalen n warraw fkan-d ikufan n lfexxaṛ akked lxwatem n usentem ; yettwabder daɣen igedwan akked yiwuraren n tɣuyit.
kids.rows.2.v: Iɣsan n yiḍaren, awuraren yemsedwayen deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan aqdim akk, ḍahren daɣen di tegnit tapunit ; leqwanin n Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is ffɣen-aɣ.
kids.rows.3.v: Imeskaren, lemqedmin akked imsezzenzen ssnen ad arun. Adlis n tfellaḥt n Magun yura s tapunikt ; Ṛuma tefka lameṛ s tsuɣelt-is ɣer tlatinit mbeɛd 146 (Pline, XVIII, 22).
kids.rows.4.v: Imeqqranen sselmaden-tt : Hanibal yesεa d aselmad Sosylos n Sparte (Cornélius Népos, Hanibal, 13). Justin (XX, 5) yeqqar-d maca legdel n lweqt n uɣra-ines, deg lqern wis 4, mbeɛd lexdeɛ.
memo.title: Mbeɛd tudert
memo.p: Imḍalen ɣer berra n lesswar, lebyuṛ n yimḍalen, ifecka n yimḍalen, izran n tofet : lɛadat n tmettant țwabedren akked ddin, aɣerbaz n yimḍalen akked taẓuri tapunit.

related.0.title: Taẓuri d lesnaɛa tipuniyen
related.0.text: Lǥawahar, ucenfiṛen, djaǧ, lfexxaṛ, akked ixxamen n Kerkouane.
related.1.title: Tutlayt d tira tipuniyen
related.1.text: Agemmay n 22 n isekkilen, tira, akked yisem-ik s tefiniqit.
related.2.title: Tafellaḥt n Qarṭaǧ
related.2.text: Magun, uzemmur, tafeṛṛant akked tazart n Caton.
